Hybrid breast augmentation

The breast augmentation is one of the most in-demand aesthetic medicine surgeries in 2024, especially técnica híbrida. This procedure is the second most popular type of breast enlargement surgery in Spain, with an average patient age range between 25 and 34.

Si estás interesada en un breast augmentation with implants in Barcelona, Clínica Belba offers the most advanced techniques and the latest in breast augmentation to achieve natural, safe and satisfying results!

.

What is hybrid breast augmentation surgery?

This innovative breast surgery in Barcelona combines the placement of breast implants with the injection of the patient's own fat, providing the desired volume and a more natural shape to the breast. aumento de pechos en Barcelona with the hybrid technique allows the surgeon to sculpt the breasts precisely, softening curves and correcting asymmetries. It is an excellent option for those looking for a breast augmentation in Barcelona con un aspecto natural.

This is because the implant helps achieve the desired volume, while the fat is used to modify the shape, soften the curves, hide the implant folds, and correct asymmetries.

When is a hybrid breast augmentation recommended?

At our breast surgery clinic in Barcelona, it is suggested when you want a breast augmentation with the most natural feel possible and defined cleavage in the upper part of the breast. It is ideal for female patients with asymmetric, narrow breasts who do not have enough breast tissue to cover the implants.

Asimismo, la breast surgery in Barcelona is advised for patients who do not want large implants, wish to avoid scars and have a stubborn area of fat they want to remove. If you decide to have a breast augmentation in Barcelona, the specialist will determine whether you are indeed a suitable candidate. The best breast augmentation in Barcelona

Expected results of breast augmentation surgery in Barcelona

What is expected from hybrid breast augmentation surgery in Barcelona varies according to individual aesthetic wishes and each patient's anatomical characteristics. In general, the expected results include improvements in the symmetry and shape of the breasts, and an improvement in breast projection and contour, como una leve elevación o mastopexia.

Furthermore, beyond satisfaction with physical appearance, this breast surgery can also mean an increase in self-esteem. This is largely due to the feeling of confidence that comes from having more beautiful and attractive breasts. The results are also expected to be natural and long-lasting.

Risks of hybrid breast augmentation surgery

The general risks of (hybrid) breast augmentation surgery are the same as those of any other surgery of this type.

Estos incluyen reacciones alérgicas o riesgo de infecciones en el sitio de la incisión, contractura capsular, necrosis de tejido, inflamación, dolor pectoral, cambios en la sensibilidad mamaria, formación de colecciones de líquido (seromas), entre otros.

Therefore, appropriate medical care is recommended to minimise the risks of breast surgery in Barcelona, as well as choosing a clinic with qualified staff and entrusting your health only to experts such as those you will find at Clínica Belba.

Breast augmentation clinic in Barcelona

Make an appointment

Preoperative assessment for surgery at our breast augmentation clinic in Barcelona (hybrid)

It is a set of examinations and diagnostic tests carried out before surgery such as a breast augmentation mammoplasty in Barcelona. It serves to check the patient's state of health and ensure they are ready for the procedure.

Pre-surgery consultation for hybrid breast augmentation in Barcelona

La consulta previa al breast augmentation in Barcelona is a clinical evaluation carried out before the surgical intervention. During it, the surgeon assesses the tamaño del pecho, la estructura ósea, la piel, el tejido graso y los músculos del área a tratar.

It also serves to give the patient information about the mammoplasty procedure in Barcelona, such as filler options, risks, complications and results. This way the patient can make an informed decision about whether hybrid breast enlargement is the most suitable option.

Indicaciones de preoperatorio en un aumento mamario híbrido

Before undergoing the procedure, the surgeon will order preoperative tests to assess your general health and determine whether there are any contraindications or potentially serious risks related to the treatment plan created.

Estas pruebas pueden consistir en análisis sanguíneos completos, radiografías pulmonares u otros exámenes necesarios para confirmar que no hay problemas subyacentes.

Además, se puede recomendar abstenerse temporalmente del consumo de alcohol, tabaco e incluso medicamentos recetados for minimizar riesgos postoperatorios. However, the most usual advice is that on the day before the operation, the patient should be as calm as possible, rest well and observe the fasting hours recommended by the anaesthetist.

Hybrid breast augmentation surgery procedure in Barcelona

Tras el preoperatorio, llega el momento de la breast surgery in Barcelona. Es importante conocer los siguientes datos antes del procedimiento.

Técnica a utilizar en mamoplastia Barcelona

This surgery involves the use of several techniques because it consists of two procedures. For implant placement, the subglandular (beneath the mammary gland) and submuscular (beneath the muscle) techniques can be used.

For the fat injection, lipotransfer or lipolifting is used. This surgical technique is used to improve the appearance of a specific area of the body by transferring the patient's own fat.

The fat is harvested from areas of the body such as the hips, thighs or upper abdomen by liposuction. A purification process is applied before it is injected into the breasts.

Breast implants

As for breast implants, there are several types according to their shape and material. They can be round (the most widely used), anatomical (more natural result) or ergonomic (they adapt to movement). They may also have a silicone or polyurethane shell, and be filled with silicone or saline solution (salt water).

Anaesthesia used in breast surgery in Barcelona

Para este tipo de operacion pechos Barcelona se emplea general anesthesia. In this way, the patient can be asleep and thus evitar que sienta cualquier dolor o molestia. Se considera la mejor alternativa para conseguir una óptima relajación muscular.

Duration of the breast surgery

It depends on several factors such as the size of the breast implants and the amount of fat needed for the filling. However, in general, it lasts between 90 minutes and 2 hours.

Post-operative care after breast augmentation in Barcelona

After the breast enlargement operation, the patient must follow certain guidelines to recover fully and achieve the desired results.

Recovery time after breast surgery in Barcelona

Tras una breast surgery in Barcelona, the recovery time is aproximadamente 3 a 4 semanas. Durante este tiempo, el paciente puede experimentar dolor, enrojecimiento, hinchazón y una sensación de presión en la zona afectada, va depender de cada caso.

The surgeon may recommend resting and avoiding strenuous activities during recovery to ensure the best possible results. It is important to follow the surgeon's instructions on post-operative care to ensure a successful recovery.

Aftercare following breast augmentation in Barcelona

Among the main aftercare measures following a hybrid breast augmentation in Barcelona is rest. In addition, the surgeon may recommend that the patient wear a special bra designed to support the breasts and speed up recovery, or take short walks to stimulate blood flow.

It is also important for the patient to wash with water and mild soap, gently dry the affected area and apply an antibiotic cream to prevent infection. The surgeon may also recommend using ice packs to reduce the swelling and pain after breast surgery in Barcelona.

The best breast augmentation surgeons in Barcelona (hybrid)

At Clínica Belba, the medical team, Dr. Félix Chavarría and Dr. Mike Dewever, perform various aesthetic procedures, including breast augmentation in Barcelona (hybrid). They apply the most innovative techniques in the field, such as Minimal scar, which reduces incisions to less than 3 cm.

Both are surgeons with extensive experience in plastic surgery. They offer individualised advice and truly impressive results, both in the aesthetic field and in the latest hybrid breast augmentation techniques in Barcelona.

They also provide the care and follow-up required to ensure the best results in all their medical rejuvenation procedures. This means you will feel safe at every stage before, during and after surgery. So if you want beautiful, aesthetically pleasing breasts, with complete safety, you will achieve it at Clínica Belba.

Preguntas Frecuentes sobre aumento de tetas Barcelona:

What is the price of breast augmentation in Barcelona?

No existe un coste fijo for the price of this type of breast surgery in Barcelona depende de factores como el tipo de implante, las zonas de las que se extraiga la grasa, el plano (delante o detrás de músculo), del preoperatorio, entre otros. Therefore, the specialists create a personalised treatment plan based on each person's requirements and needs. As a result, the price of each breast surgery in Barcelona is tailored accordingly. You can ask us about the treatment via the WhatsApp link, which will open a new conversation window, or on the website by email. peso Breast surgery price in Barcelona.

Aumento senos Barcelona 

What scars does breast augmentation in Barcelona leave?

Esta breast surgery in Barcelona deja cicatrices en la misma zona donde se hacen las incisiones, que dependen del tipo de procedimiento. Generalmente se hacen en el surco mamario, donde dejan cicatrices casi invisibles.

Their size also depends on the implant used. However, scars can be minimised through surgical techniques such as minimal scar.

Por otro lado, debes saber que con el paso del tiempo estas son casi imperceptibles.

breast augmentation in Barcelona

Why is hybrid breast augmentation considered the latest in breast augmentation surgery?

The hybrid technique is considered the latest in breast augmentation in Barcelona because of its benefits. Combining the placement of breast implants with fat injection achieves natural results with a softer appearance.

In addition, this technique is less invasive than traditional breast augmentation methods, which means less pain and a faster recovery. It also allows patients to avoid the need for long-term implant replacement surgery.

price of breast augmentation in Barcelona

When is a good time for a hybrid breast augmentation?

The most suitable time to undergo a hybrid breast augmentation depends on the time available for recovery and on geographical location. In general, the best time is when temperatures are low, to avoid exposure to excessive heat, which can reduce the success rate of the surgery.

In fact, some surgeons recommend scheduling the surgery for spring or autumn so that the patient has enough time to recover before summer.

However, it is important to bear in mind that surgery should be scheduled when the patient is healthy enough and when the surgeon determines that they are a good candidate for the procedure.

tetas Barcelona

What does it feel like to have breast augmentation surgery?

Operated breasts feel different from natural ones. Some people say they feel heavier and also firmer. In addition, since the size and shape of the breasts also change with surgery, how they feel may change.

On the other hand, having breast surgery is also associated with increased self-esteem. Some studies suggest that people who undergo this type of procedure experience a positive change in their self-esteem and body image.

aumento de pectorales con prótesis en Barcelona

Is sensation lost after breast augmentation with implants in Barcelona?

Some studies show that breast sensitivity may decrease after breast augmentation surgery. This is mainly due to the manipulation of tissues during surgery and the formation of scar tissue around the implant.
However, most patients report that this sensitivity returns to normal after a few months. Some people also report a permanent decrease in sensitivity, but this is less common.

Breast augmentation Barcelona price

Which is better, breast augmentation with your own fat (lipotransfer) or using implants?

The choice between breast augmentation with your own fat or using implants depends on several factors. Lipotransfer is a good option for those who want a subtle, natural increase in volume.

However, breast implants are a more effective option if a significant increase is desired. The patient's health and general condition must also be taken into account, as lipotransfer may not be a viable option for those with an insufficient amount of fat.

Therefore, it is important to consult with the surgeon to assess which is the best option for the patient.

@graph.description: Inició sus estudios en la Université Libre de Bruxelles y terminó licenciándose en la Universidad de Barcelona y recibiendo el premio extraordinario de licenciatura por sus brillantes resultados académicos. mainEntity.name: ¿Qué cicatrices deja el aumento de mamas Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Esta cirugía mamaria Barcelona deja cicatrices en la misma zona donde se hacen las incisiones, que dependen del tipo de procedimiento. Generalmente se hacen en el surco mamario, donde dejan cicatrices casi invisibles.

Su tamaño también depende del implante usado. Sin embargo, las cicatrices pueden ser minimizadas mediante técnicas quirúrgicas como el minimal scar.

Por otro lado, debes saber que con el paso del tiempo estas son casi imperceptibles.

aumento pecho en Barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Por qué el aumento de mama híbrido se considera lo último en cirugía de aumento de pechos?

acceptedAnswer.text:
La técnica híbrida se considera lo último en aumento senos Barcelona por sus beneficios. Al combinar la colocación de implantes de mamas con la inyección de grasa se consiguen resultados naturales y con un aspecto más suave.

Además, esta técnica es menos invasiva que los métodos tradicionales de aumento de pechos, lo que significa menos dolor y una recuperación más rápida. Esto también permite a los pacientes evitar la necesidad de una cirugía de reemplazo de implantes a largo plazo.

aumento de pecho precio Barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué momento es bueno para un aumento híbrido de pecho?

acceptedAnswer.text:
El momento más adecuado para someterse a un aumento híbrido de pecho depende de la disponibilidad de tiempo para la recuperación y de la ubicación geográfica. En general, el mejor momento es cuando las temperaturas están bajas para evitar la exposición al calor excesivo, que puede reducir la tasa de éxito de la cirugía.

De hecho, algunos cirujanos recomiendan programar la cirugía para la primavera o el otoño para que el paciente tenga suficiente tiempo para la recuperación antes del verano.

Sin embargo, es importante tener en cuenta que la cirugía debe ser programada cuando el paciente esté lo suficientemente saludable y cuando el cirujano determine que es un buen candidato para el procedimiento.

tetas Barcelona

mainEntity.name: What does it feel like to have breast augmentation surgery?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Los senos operados se sienten diferentes a los naturales. Algunas personas aseguran que se sienten más pesados y también más firmes. Además, dado que el tamaño y la forma de los pechos también cambian con la cirugía, puede cambiar su sensación.

Por otro lado, operarse el pecho también tiene relación con un aumento de la autoestima. Algunos estudios sugieren que quienes se someten a este tipo de procedimientos, tienen un cambio positivo en su autoestima e imagen corporal.

aumento de pectorales con prótesis en Barcelona

mainEntity.name: ¿Se pierde la sensibilidad luego del aumento de pecho con prótesis en Barcelona?

acceptedAnswer.text:
Algunos estudios muestran que la sensibilidad en los senos puede disminuir después de la operación de aumento de pecho. Esto se debe, principalmente, a la manipulación de los tejidos durante la cirugía y a la formación de una cicatriz que rodea el implante.
Sin embargo, la mayoría de los pacientes informan que esta sensibilidad regresa a la normalidad después de unos meses. Algunas personas también informan una disminución permanente en la sensibilidad, pero esto es menos común.

Breast augmentation Barcelona price

mainEntity.name: ¿Qué es mejor, el aumento de pecho con grasa propia (lipotransferencia) o el uso de implantes?

acceptedAnswer.text:
La elección entre el aumento de senos con grasa propia o el uso de implantes depende de varios factores. La lipotransferencia es una buena opción para aquellas personas que quieren un aumento de volumen sutil y natural.

Sin embargo, los implantes de pecho son una opción más efectiva si se desea un aumento significativo. También hay que tener en cuenta la salud y el estado general del paciente, ya que la lipotransferencia puede no ser una opción viable para aquellos con una cantidad de grasa insuficiente.

Por lo tanto, es importante consultar con el cirujano para evaluar cuál es la mejor opción para el paciente.

aumento de pecho con grasa en Barcelona
